commit.message:
LU-20076 tests: ping MDC imports to revalidate

just waiting for FULL state is not enough as an import can be
already in FULL, but hasn't noticed it's evicted. so it makes
sense to ping.

Fixes: ae1b0a7097 ("LU-20076 target: sync before waiting for exports at umount")
Signed-off-by: Alex Zhuravlev <azhuravlev@thelustrecollective.com>
